description: Source code for the AccountingDimension doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, methods for validation, creation, deletion, and retrieval of accounting dimension data.

classes.name: AccountingDimension
classes.description: Represents an accounting dimension document with methods for validation, setup, and lifecycle events.

methods.name: make_dimension_in_accounting_doctypes
methods.description: Creates custom fields for accounting dimensions across relevant doctypes.

methods.name: add_dimension_to_budget_doctype
methods.description: Adds a dimension field to the Budget doctype with specific dependencies.

methods.name: delete_accounting_dimension
methods.description: Removes dimension fields and updates related property setters.

methods.name: disable_dimension
methods.description: Enqueues or directly toggles the disabled state of a dimension.

methods.name: toggle_disabling
methods.description: Enables or disables dimension fields by updating custom field properties.

methods.name: get_doctypes_with_dimensions
methods.description: Retrieves list of doctypes that have accounting dimensions configured.

methods.name: get_accounting_dimensions
methods.description: Fetches all accounting dimensions, optionally as a list.

methods.name: get_checks_for_pl_and_bs_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves accounting dimension details for profit & loss and balance sheet accounts.

methods.name: get_dimension_with_children
methods.description: Gets all child dimensions of a given dimension in a doctype.

methods.name: get_dimensions
methods.description: Returns active dimensions and default dimension mappings, with optional inclusion of cost center and project.
